name: Dev Container with Docker + AI CLIs
postCreateCommand: sudo chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock || true && npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code @google/gemini-cli @openai/codex && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libcups2 libdrm2 libxkbcommon0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libasound2 && cd /workspaces/GrowChat && npm install @playwright/cli@latest --save-dev && sudo ln -sf /workspaces/GrowChat/node_modules/.bin/playwright-cli /usr/local/bin/playwright-cli && npx playwright install chromium chrome
